---
title: "Grading"
---

::: {.callout-warning}
This policy is **tentative** until the first week of class.
:::

Everything is out of **100 marks**.

| Component | Marks | How |
|---|:---:|---|
| **Quizzes** | **54** | Three quizzes; your **best two** count, **27 marks each**. |
| **Assignments** | **39** | Three programming assignments, **13 marks each**. |
| **Attendance** | **7** | Biometric-tracked (see below). |

## Quizzes — 54

- Three quizzes through the semester; the **best two of three** count, so a single bad day is forgiven.
- **Closed book.** A mix of short conceptual questions and problems.
- **No makeup quizzes** — a missed quiz is simply one of the dropped scores.

## Assignments — 39

- **Three** assignments, **13 marks each**, in **Python + PyTorch**. Each extends code you have already seen in a lecture notebook.
- Each is a **programming** submission by the deadline.
- **After the deadline**, every student takes a **short individual quiz / viva** on their own submission — you explain your code, your plots, and your choices. Your marks reflect that conversation, so submit work you can defend.

::: {.callout-note}
Use AI tools honestly and document meaningful assistance. What is assessed is your ability to explain your own decisions and results in the viva.
:::

## Attendance — 7

Attendance is recorded on the **biometric system** — it is your responsibility to ensure it registers.

| Classes missed | Marks |
|:---:|:---:|
| ≤ 4 | 7 |
| 5–6 | 5 |
| 7–8 | 3 |
| 9–10 | 1 |
| > 10 | 0 |

There is no leave-request system; a missed class is an absence. For a genuine emergency that forces you to miss several classes in a row, talk to the instructor.
